rows.text: Trom Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts (Rs 3.21 cr) (~6.0% of mcap)
secures a Rs 4.81 cr rooftop-solar order from the Gujarat Energy Development Agency, including a 10-year maintenance contract, 12-month delivery
receives a **Rs 4.81 cr** purchase order from Gujarat Energy Development Agency for a 10-year solar-rooftop supply-and-maintenance contract
